protocol.runner: fresh Codex subagents with inherited identical settings

cases.observation: The skill added explicit AHE selection, a single Agent-orchestration path, mechanism-owned admission/finalize/verify transitions, and child-worktree completion criteria.
Both Agents correctly recovered activation and access rules; the skill produced no correctness gain on this repository-discoverable case.

limitations: This baseline predates the merge of evolve-workspace into the unified evolve-agent skill and should not be treated as a score for the current revision.
This is a two-case smoke baseline, not the full behavior suite.
Invocation cases were not run through an installed-skill router.
No downstream candidate-quality or benchmark improvement was measured.
Tool-call count, latency, token use, and reference-loading cost were not captured.
